product: MM-ART-010 parameterized permanent one-off city-map wall relief with complete water apertures and S/U transit accent

scope.intended_use: Unique indoor decorative Berlin wall relief, produced as two four-color main prints and permanently assembled without adhesive, rear grid, magnets, or replaceable sections. Revision 0.5.2 changes visible geometry: every retained mapped water area and river/canal/stream becomes a light-through opening, Sky Blue represents S-Bahn/U-Bahn plus the existing context boundary and site marker, and motorway/trunk remains Midnight. Revision 0.5.1 digital-candidate-r4 is rejected and no revision 0.5.2 manufacturing geometry exists before the human gates.
scope.user_context: Adult indoor customer; optional customer-supplied low-power rear halo/front-through lighting; production on the Anycubic Kobra 3 Max Combo.

failure_modes.mode: Wrong location, unreadable artwork, fifth color, or collision with protected geometry
failure_modes.effect: Misleading or visually defective one-off artwork; slice or assembly may fail
failure_modes.mitigation: Freeze geocode provenance, parameterize artwork independently, reuse one existing tool and rerun deterministic placement, feature, mesh and slicer checks

acceptance_criteria: Digital analysis confirms that the canonical stacked metriMade artwork is centered on the frozen address, measures 54.0 × 57.18 mm with aspect ratio preserved, lies on exactly one retained main half, keeps at least 50 mm from the center seam and 5 mm from the outer perimeter, has no printable feature below 0.9 mm, rises 0.6 mm and uses tool 4. A human recognizes it at 2.0 m under ordinary indoor lighting on a process-matched Oak/Sky Blue coupon.

criticality.rationale: The artwork is decorative, but a failed printed wall interface or unsuitable customer lighting has credible injury, property-damage, or heat consequences and therefore requires controlled tests.

decision.rationale: Requirements for revision 0.5.2 are explicit and concept evidence can proceed. Production CAD, mesh and 3MF work is controlled by pending concept/decomposition approval and by reacquisition of a context-complete source. Revision 0.5.1 is retained only as rejected historical evidence because it omitted water-area multipolygons and assigned Sky Blue to motorway accents.

warnings.message: The selected canonical metriMade vector asset MM-BRAND-001-R1 is recorded as clearance pending; commercial release remains blocked.
The 54.0 mm stacked lockup targets recognition from 2.0 m, but renders and digital dimensions cannot prove human readability; a process-matched coupon is required.
The one-way connector and snap-in mounting interfaces have no exact process-qualified clearance or physical result.
Concealed seam pockets must remain printable in the face-up main-part orientation and must not create unsupported roofs or visible read-through.
The physical spool products are identified, but common-process compatibility, opacity, directed purge, conditioning, ACE slots and numeric mechanical thresholds remain unverified.

Revision 0.5.1 project files are mesh-readable but omit water-area multipolygons including Tegeler See and use Sky Blue for motorway accents; they must not be printed or released as the corrected map.
Concept v07 changes visible negative and color geometry and therefore needs explicit human approval before the decomposition and manufacturing build.
The local Berlin PBF proves the corrected feature classes but not the full context-outline margin; the recorded context-complete source must be reacquired, hashed and re-extracted before production.
